description: Implementation of ProvisioningCriteriaReadPlatformService for retrieving provisioning criteria data, templates, and definitions from the database in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing provisioning criteria retrieval logic, including templates and detailed criteria data.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaRowMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set rows to ProvisioningCriteriaData objects for listing all provisioning criteria.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionRowMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set rows to ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionData objects for provisioning criteria definitions.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaNameRowMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set rows to String representing criteria name.

methods.name: retrievePrivisiongCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning criteria template with categories, loan products, and GL accounts.

methods.name: retrievePrivisiongCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Overloaded method that populates a template with existing data, categories, loan products, and GL accounts.

methods.name: constructCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Constructs a list of provisioning criteria definitions from categories.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningCriterias
methods.description: Retrieves all provisioning criteria records from the database.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to ProvisioningCriteriaData.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string for provisioning criteria listing.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves detailed provisioning criteria by ID, including associated loan products and definitions.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning criteria definitions for a given criteria ID.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to ProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionData.

methods.name: retrieveCriteriaName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a provisioning criteria by ID.

methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a String representing criteria name.
